target_customer: Data center owners, operators, tenants, facilities managers and engineering teams
problem: Data center engineering and operations rely on manual procedures, drawings and tribal knowledge, so issues are found late and uptime suffers.
business_model: Enterprise software, sold by demo (pricing not public)
product_category: AI platform for data center engineering and operations

founders.name: Shapol M
founders.background_notes: The YC page gives only the name as shown and no background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Linking drawings, equipment records and telemetry into a site model with AI procedure review is substantial integration work but not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: A per-site model of equipment and procedures becomes sticky once adopted, but it was unproven in 2024.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DCIM vendors added AI features by 2025 and 2026; no acquisition of Entangl found.

market_need_then: AI data center buildout in 2024 raised demand for faster commissioning and tighter operations, though no dated evidence specific to this wedge was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses entangl.com; some sources cite entangl.ai. Similar names Entagl and Entanglement exist.

identity.visual_style: Calm technical site with italic accents
identity.voice_and_tone: Calm, direct, precise, hedged claims, tagline 'Your knowledge. Put to work.'

brand_strength.rationale: Missing-vowel coinage is easy to confuse with Entagl and Entanglement; no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Entangl is active with a reported team of 22 and a data center AI focus riding the 2024 buildout. Funding and customers are not publicly verified and no outcome events were found, so the company's trajectory is unknown. Aggregators suggest only a small seed; confidence is low.
notes: Aggregators only, unverified: CB Insights shows about $500K total with a Seed dated 2024-12-09 and investors Transpose Platform, Tekedia Capital, Y Combinator, Eight Capital Group, Evolution VC Partners; VCBacked lists Y Combinator, 468 Capital, Evolution VC Partners. Search snippets name a second co-founder (Antanas Zilinskas) but the YC page fetched lists only Shapol M, so not recorded. No dated competitor evidence near the Summer 2024 batch was found.
